services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Escape to the pristine waters of the Savage River Reservoir for an unforgettable kayak tour just 30 minutes from Deep Creek Lake, Maryland. Our guided kayaking adventures offer the perfect blend of relaxation, education, and wildlife viewing in one of Garrett County's most spectacular natural settings. Experience kayaking on Savage River Reservoir, a crystal-clear mountain lake nestled in the heart of Savage River State Forest. With no motorboats allowed and zero development, you'll enjoy peaceful paddling surrounded by untouched wilderness and stunning mountain views. blurb: All Earth Eco Tours offers kayak tours, nature walks, and creative outdoor events in the natural setting of Deep Creek Lake, Garrett County, Maryland. Their experiences focus on reconnecting guests with nature and providing memorable journeys into the outdoors. They also offer programs such as Birds of Prey, snowshoe tours, foraging, farm camp, and wellness activities like yoga and sound baths.
